Question.title: Question
Question.description: Represents a multiple-choice school quiz question with 3 options (A, B, C).

optA.description: Text for multiple choice option A.

optB.description: Text for multiple choice option B.

optC.description: Text for multiple choice option C.

isPublished.description: Whether the question is visible to all quiz participants.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the question was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the question was last updated.

GlobalSettings.title: GlobalSettings
GlobalSettings.description: Global quiz configuration including persistent default A, B, C options and VPN Portal Host settings.

optA.description: Saved default text for option A across all questions.

optB.description: Saved default text for option B across all questions.

optC.description: Saved default text for option C across all questions.

customVpnHost.description: Configured custom VPN Host IP or domain URL.

isPublished.description: Whether the global configuration is active for all clients.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when settings were last updated.

Submission.title: Submission
Submission.description: Represents a completed anonymous quiz submission summary.

totalQuestions.description: Total number of questions answered in this submission.

countA.description: Count of option A choices in this submission.

countB.description: Count of option B choices in this submission.

countC.description: Count of option C choices in this submission.

isAnonymous.description: Always true to guarantee anonymous submission.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the submission was recorded.

QuestionResponse.title: QuestionResponse
QuestionResponse.description: Represents an individual anonymous vote for a specific question within a submission.

id.description: Unique identifier for the question response.

submissionId.description: Reference ID of the parent Submission document.

questionId.description: Reference ID of the answered Question document.

selectedOption.description: Chosen option index: 0 for A, 1 for B, 2 for C.

isAnonymous.description: Always true to guarantee anonymous response.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the response was recorded.

VpnGateway.title: VpnGateway
VpnGateway.description: Represents a registered VPN Portal Host gateway endpoint.

id.description: Unique identifier for the VPN gateway.

label.description: Display label for the VPN gateway (e.g., Radmin Sala 1, Tailscale Escola).

hostUrl.description: URL or IP:Port of the VPN host endpoint.

provider.description: VPN provider type (Tailscale, Radmin, ZeroTier, Hamachi, WireGuard).

isPublished.description: Whether the gateway is active and listed in the portal.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the gateway was registered.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the gateway was last updated.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

email.description: Verified email address of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created.

/questions/{questionId}.description: Stores multiple-choice school quiz questions (A, B, C) visible to all users.

/settings/{settingId}.description: Stores global default A, B, C option labels and VPN Portal Host configuration.

/submissions/{submissionId}.description: Stores anonymous completed quiz submission summaries.

/responses/{responseId}.description: Stores individual per-question anonymous votes linked to a submission and question.

/vpnGateways/{gatewayId}.description: Stores VPN Portal Host endpoints configured by the administrator.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Stores administrator UIDs and verified emails.
